description: Execute a previously simulated DeFi strategy on-chain. REQUIRES confirm=true as a safety rail. Executes steps sequentially, reporting each transaction. Stops immediately if any step fails. Returns all tx hashes, gas used, and final state.

api_key.description: Premium API key for execution access

confirm.description: Must be true to execute. Safety rail to prevent accidental execution.

slippage_bps.description: Max slippage in basis points (100 = 1%). Default: 100

strategy_id.description: Strategy ID from a previous defi_simulate_strategy call

name: defi_execute_strategy
